_note: Exact mock data for POE-362. Do NOT invent or widen fields. One owner. Each record is a GET /api/device/me outcome; the shapes are the live server's (internal/server/handlers/device.go, deviceMeResponse). The alias is the dialog's own placeholder example, not a real device.

_owners.registration: derived (client, this task): from deviceMe / identify per README § Interactions & state

unregisteredEmpty._note: empty string reads as unregistered, like null

unknownOldServer._note: no alias key at all → unknown

unknownFailed._note: request rejected (network error / non-2xx) → unknown; retries continue

checking._note: no answer yet for this device id, or just after a server switch

success._note: POST response body; the button takes this alias at once

_formats.initial: first character of alias.trim(), by code point ([...s][0]), toUpperCase()
_formats.ariaAlias: no quotes: 'Account: registered as Gaming PC'
